ttm.shares_basis: duration-weighted average of the four quarterly diluted weighted-average counts (a fiscal-Q4 count derived as 4 x FY - the other three quarters)

dividends.dps_ttm_basis: FY2025 DPS 8 + the quarters since (2026-03-31: 2, 2026-06-30: 2) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-03-31: 2, 2025-06-30: 2)
dividends.frequency_basis: 3 quarterly DPS facts inside FY2025 (2025-01-01..2025-12-31) plus one payment carried only in the FY total; the per-share facts are filed per quarter — a payment cadence inside the quarter (a monthly payer) is not tagged
dividends.fy_label_basis: calendar year of the fiscal period end (the annual table's convention)
dividends.flows_basis: sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30
dividends.price_note: price: neither prices.json nor score.json carries a price — yields null
dividends.shareholder_yield_basis: dividends_paid (4/4 quarters filed) + buybacks (4/4 quarters filed) − share_issuance (1/4 quarters filed (2026-03-31) — a lower bound); sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30

dividend_yield.basis: FY2025 DPS 8 + the quarters since (2026-03-31: 2, 2026-06-30: 2) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-03-31: 2, 2025-06-30: 2)
